body.purpose: Open Sans paragraphs with responsive size reductions.

card-description.purpose: Secondary labels on the dark caption band.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Hover-capable pointer card lift of 5px and green border.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables CSS animations/transitions and hover movement, makes WOW content visible, and skips JavaScript reveal.

components.name: Hero action
components.description: Existing uppercase action on the textured hero; mobile padding and text size shrink.
components.css: .ds-hero { display: inline-block; background: var(--brand-green, #22f603); color: var(--brand-ink, #11240b); padding: 15px 30px; border-radius: 3px; font: 400 16px/25px Montserrat, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-hero:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-hero:active, .ds-hero:focus { background: var(--brand-green, #22f603); } .ds-hero:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-green, #22f603) !important; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-hero { font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 25px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero, .ds-submit, .ds-filter, .ds-card, .ds-arrow, .ds-field, .ds-nav a { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Email draft action
components.description: Existing form submit action opens an email draft. Preview has no form behavior.
components.css: .ds-submit { width: 175px; max-width: 100%; min-height: 50px; height: auto; white-space: normal; background: var(--brand-green, #22f603); color: var(--brand-ink, #11240b); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 400 14px Montserrat, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-submit:hover { background: #111; color: #fff; } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-green, #22f603); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero, .ds-submit, .ds-filter, .ds-card, .ds-arrow, .ds-field, .ds-nav a { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Portfolio category
components.description: Native filter buttons; aria-pressed is managed by the actual site JavaScript.
components.html: <button class="ds-filter" type="button" aria-pressed="true">All</button> <button class="ds-filter" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Web Sites</button>
components.css: .ds-filter { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #eff3ed; color: #31422e; font: 12px Montserrat, sans-serif; padding: 13px 21px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"], .ds-filter:hover { color: var(--brand-ink, #11240b); background: var(--brand-green, #22f603); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-green, #22f603); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-filter { padding: 12px 15px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero, .ds-submit, .ds-filter, .ds-card, .ds-arrow, .ds-field, .ds-nav a { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Contact field
components.description: Current single-line field and existing focus glow; no custom validation state.
components.css: .ds-field { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 50px; padding: 15px 16px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; font: 15px "Open Sans", sans-serif; color: #333; transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--brand-green, #22f603); outline: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.075), 0 0 8px rgba(124, 197, 118, 0.3); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero, .ds-submit, .ds-filter, .ds-card, .ds-arrow, .ds-field, .ds-nav a { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: none; } } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #666; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Desktop navigation link excerpt
components.description: First three links from the desktop navigation. Full source adds the centered 130px logo and three items on the other side; below 992px a centered mobile logo and menu button replace the desktop strip.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #dddddd; box-shadow: 0 4px 5px -3px #ececec; text-align: center; } .ds-nav a { display: block; margin: 0; padding: 24px 8px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: #222222; font: 12px/20px Montserrat, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--brand-ink, #11240b); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--brand-green, #22f603); text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-ink, #11240b) !important; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a { transition: none; } }

components.name: Portfolio caption band (provisional)
components.description: Caption-only excerpt of the current card, omitting image dependencies. Temporarily accepted; not the final endorsed aesthetic.

components.css: .ds-card { display: block; overflow: hidden; background: #172017; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #d8e4d6; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-caption { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 22px; min-height: 106px; } .ds-caption h3 { color: #fff; margin: 0 0 8px; font: 400 16px/1.4 Montserrat, sans-serif; } .ds-caption p { color: #c7dac3; margin: 0; font: 13px/1.5 "Open Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-arrow { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 34px; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brand-green, #22f603); color: #172017; } .ds-arrow svg { transition: transform 260ms ease; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-ink, #11240b) !important; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); border-color: var(--brand-green, #22f603); } .ds-card:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } } @media (max-width: 599px) { .ds-caption { padding: 20px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card, .ds-arrow svg { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:hover svg { transform: none; } }

components.name: Email-only contact panel
components.description: Single established contact channel; email remains LTR in Arabic.
components.css: .ds-email { padding: 30px; border-radius: 12px; background: #eff4ed; } .ds-email h3 { margin: 0 0 18px; color: #222222; font: 400 15px/28px Montserrat, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-email a { font: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px)/28px "Open Sans", sans-serif; color: var(--brand-ink, #11240b); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--brand-green, #22f603); text-underline-offset: 5px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate; display: inline-block; } .ds-email a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-ink, #11240b) !important; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.northStar: Preserve the existing RoboTec style and logo-green
narrative.overview:
This document records the implemented website, rather than proposing a new visual identity. Preserve the original black textured hero, lightning and wordmark imagery, Montserrat headings, Open Sans body text, and white content sections. The owner specifically requested that the accent match the logo; the sampled logo-green and dark green ink are the current brand variables.

The portfolio currently contains 13 responsive image cards with dark caption bands and green arrow circles. The owner said the cards are still not nice but are “ok for now” until projects are replaced. Their implementation is documented as temporary acceptance, not a final endorsed card aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Existing textured black hero and footer with original RoboTec identity assets.
White and pale neutral content sections, uppercase section headings, and logo-green actions.
Responsive portfolio imagery with dark captions; current card styling remains provisional.
Eight language variants, including an Arabic RTL layout, and email-only contact.

rules.name: The Logo Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep the primary accent aligned with the existing lightning asset; do not introduce a replacement palette as part of routine page work.

dos: **Do** preserve the original textured black hero, lightning, wordmark, and Montserrat/Open Sans pairing.
**Do** use the existing logo-green and dark green ink for the current accent roles.
**Do** preserve contained project images, responsive grid behavior, native filter buttons, and reduced-motion handling.
**Do** keep email-only contact at Robotec.app@gmail.com and support all eight established language variants, including RTL Arabic.
**Do** treat the current portfolio card aesthetic as temporarily accepted pending project replacement.
donts: **Don't** invent a new visual identity, palette, or product claims from this documentation.
**Don't** claim the current portfolio card appearance is a final owner-endorsed design.
**Don't** add phone, address, or social-contact channels or claim the email-draft form sends mail through a server.
**Don't** publish or expose the original private Laravel repository as part of static-site work.
